Metadata.title: Lexora
Metadata.description: Learn and keep your A1–B2 English with active recall and spaced repetition.

Home.title: Lexora
Home.tagline: Learn and keep your A1–B2 English through active recall.
Home.problem: Recognising a word when you see it is not the same as recalling it when you want to speak or write. They are different abilities, and they fade at different rates.
Home.approach: Lexora splits each concept into the skills it is made of and schedules each one separately, with spaced repetition. Being able to recognise a word does not mark its production as learned.
Home.status: A personal learning app in development. Sign in with your account to study.

DataExport.title: Keep your data with you
DataExport.description: Download your courses, content and saved activity, including archived records. Passwords and credentials are excluded.
DataExport.jsonNote: Preserves fields, identifiers and relationships in a versioned technical format. The app does not automatically restore this file.
DataExport.csvNote: For a spreadsheet: each row identifies its source and includes its complete data. Cells that could be formulas are exported as text.
DataExport.privacy: Files contain your unencrypted data. Keep them somewhere private. You can request an export once a minute; a failed download does not produce a partial file.
DataExport.success: Download prepared. Your browser handles where to save it.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Make Lexora fit your rhythm. Your preferences are saved to your account and restored when you enter from another device.
Settings.timeZoneNote: Use an IANA name, such as Europe/Madrid. Daily allowances reset at midnight in this zone; changing it may change what is available today.
Settings.maximumReviewsNote: Leave empty for unlimited reviews. From 0 to 2,000; 0 pauses cards in Review.
Settings.limitsNote: From 0 to 100 new cards. Due learning steps remain available when an allowance is reached; lowering a limit does not undo saved reviews.
Settings.showIntervals: Show an estimate of the next interval after revealing the answer. You can toggle its visibility during the session.
Settings.courseNote: Switching course preserves its content and its own limits. Save any pending preference changes first.

errors.invalid: Check the highlighted fields. Choose a supported language and theme, an IANA time zone and whole-number limits within the stated range.
